Loading data for Orange County. 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(tmap)
library(spData)

# Reading in the database of EJScreen data at the Census Block Group level
ejscreen <- sf::st_read(here::here("EDS223-HW1", "data", "ejscreen", "EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb"))

# Filtering to a state that I'm interested in
california <- ejscreen %>% 
    dplyr::filter(ST_ABBREV == "CA")

# Filter to a county I am interested in 
orange_county <- ejscreen %>%
    dplyr::filter(CNTY_NAME %in% c("Orange County"))

# Find the average values for all variables within counties 
california_counties <- aggregate(california, by = list(california$CNTY_NAME), FUN = mean)

```
